sloka: ततः तत् कर्म सिद्धि अर्थम् पुत्रान् तस्य गतो नृपः ।वासिष्ठा दीर्घ तपसः तपो यत्र हि तेपिरे ॥१-५७-१४॥
transliteration: tataḥ tat karma siddhi artham putrān tasya gato nṛpaḥ ।vāsiṣṭhā dīrgha tapasaḥ tapo yatra hi tepire ॥1-57-14॥

translations.english: Exceedingly energetic and deeply pious, he looked at the king who was frightful in appearance and addressed him with compassion saying, "welfare to you".
